notes.title: bugfix 2025/6/24
notes.content:
1. lowered the difficulty of the second level to make some of the anomalies appear more obvious.
2. fixed a wall shadow bug in the secret level.
3. fixed the control logic of the VCR play button in the secret level.

notes.content: Fixed several minor bugs in the 2 newly added levels

notes.content: Fixed several minor bugs in the 2 newly added levels

notes.title: Major Update June 22, 2025
notes.content: [p]1. added 2 new levels: Midnight Parking Lot and Mystery Patient[/p][p]2. added a new hidden ending[/p][p]3. added three new achievements[/p][p]4. fixed the bug that the elevator door may not open in some cases.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45152660/ce4ee1c2161135f3c6ac38426fed27721d8a8066.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Bugfix 2025/5/22
notes.content:
[list]
[*] 1. Fixed a bug where the text was displayed incorrectly after installing the game on Spanish and German operating systems.
[*] 2. fixed a bug in the third level where the player can fall out of the map in certain positions
[*] 3. Added a small egg in the third level.
[*] 4. reduced the length of the countdown in the basement levels and improved the pace of the game.
[/list]

notes.title: bugfix 2025/03/27
notes.content:
1. fixed a hint text display error
2. fixed several 3D models

notes.title: bugfix 2025/03/16
notes.content:
1. Fixed several text display errors
2. Modified several ambient sound effects

notes.title: bugfix 2025/03/15
notes.content:
1. Fixed the bug that you can jump out of the elevator door when the elevator is running
2. Fixed the bug that you can jump out of the map at the entrance of the subway station in level 4
3. Fixed the bug that moving while checking an item may cause the item not to be put back to its original position

notes.title: bugfix 2025/03/15
notes.content:
1. fixed some minor issues in level 6
2. fixed the bug that the gameover menu button could not be clicked in some cases
3. brightened the ambient light in the basement level

notes.title: Optimize game content 2025/3/14
notes.content:
1. Increase the brightness of the elevator button display on the second level's outer wall, and add multiple ambient light sources in the street.
2. Repair the display error of some tips.
3. Modified the fourth level to return to the ground instead of dying after falling on the platform.
4. Increased ambient light brightness in level 5.
5. Level 6 pool gameplay has been modified from finding anomalies to solving puzzles and chasing gameplay.

notes.title: bugfix 2025/03/10
notes.content:
1. fixed the bug that resets the game progress after the second level is completed
2. Fixed a bug where changing the settings in the game would mess up the language display.

There are many bugs in the game after release, thanks for your patience in waiting for the patch!

notes.title: bugfix 2025/03/10 (Mac and Linux versions)

notes.title: 2025/03/09 bugfix (Windows version)
notes.content: Fixed the bug that the saved progress of the game may be lost in Windows version

notes.title: bugfix 2025/03/09
notes.content:
1. Fixed a bug where some prompts were not correctly translated into the relevant language.
2. Fixed a bug where you could fall off the map in a certain room.

notes.title: Bugfix 2025/3/7
notes.content:
1. Fixed the bug that you can't re-enter the game after entering the secret room level.
2. Fixed the bug that you can't jump on certain platforms.
3. Fixed the bug that the secret room level will fall out of the map in certain places.
4. Fixed the bug that the videotape in the backpack cannot be used.
5. Fixed the bug that the model's arm can't be interacted with.
